main.description: A TorTok short-form video post. Bytes are addressed by a magnet URI; the record carries metadata and a thumbnail blob hosted on the author's PDS.

magnetUri.description: BitTorrent magnet URI. Includes the info hash (xt=urn:btih:...), display name, tracker list, and one or more BEP-19 webseed URLs.

infoHash.description: SHA-1 info hash, lowercase hex. Redundant with the magnet URI but useful as an indexable column.

aspectRatio.description: Display dimensions of the video. Shape matches app.bsky.embed.defs#aspectRatio so Decision 0010's inbound Bluesky-video bridge does not have to translate shapes.

thumbnailBlob.description: Poster image. Stored as a blob in the author's PDS.

torrentBlob.description: The post's .torrent file. Lets a client start the torrent with no peer. Clients use it only if its info dictionary hashes to infoHash.
